summary: In-process harness frames recorded bundled images at their machine-local file: URL (the account screen's Google sign-in mark, new URL('./google-g.png', import.meta.url)). The UI-quality replay allows only data: images and blocks file://, so decoding failed ('The source image cannot be decoded.') and every nightly visual gate since the mark was added ended in a tooling failure. Frame capture now embeds each local image as a data: URI and fails capture if the file cannot be read.
